scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=backend && npm run test:unit --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
